# DietaryField

## Summary

DietaryField is the dietary-restriction enum used on Guest — a `StringField` enum whose options come from `DIETARY_OPTIONS` in `../utils/index`: Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal, Kosher, Gluten-free, Dairy-free, Nut Allergy, and Shellfish Allergy. Guests hold it in a `containsMany`, since one guest can carry several restrictions at once; `dietaryLabel` maps a value back to its display label.

## Import

```js
import { DietaryField } from '../guest';
```

## Usage as a Field

```ts
@field dietary = containsMany(DietaryField);
```

## Template Usage

```handlebars
{{#each @model.dietary as |d|}}{{dietaryLabel d}}{{/each}}
```
